newsitem.title: FRANCE: French M6 has funds for digital TV - paper.
newsitem.headline: French M6 has funds for digital TV - paper.

text.p: French urban television channel M6-Metropole TV has between 700 and 800 million francs in cash to meet its 20 percent share in developing the TPS digital satellite television service, managing director Nicolas Tavernost told newspaper Les Echos.

"M6 has the financial capability to undertake such an investment. Digital (television) is the life insurance policy for M6," he said in an interview to appear on Friday. "What's more, the channel has absolutely no debt and its cash position fluctuates between 700 and 800 million francs, which allows us easily to finance up to 20 percent..." he said.
M6, with parents Lyonnaise des Eaux and Luxembourg's CLT, hold 50 percent of Television par Satellite. (TPS), he said. The other TPS partners are TF1 and state-owned France Television.
TPS rivals the CanalSatellite service, launched by Canal Plus. Luxembourg holding company Audiofina controls CLT.
